svg.title: V6 · MR2: later cohorts do not rescue the primary question
svg.desc: Two panels cover cohorts one through three of new schools. Admissions estimates lack intervals and all three cohorts remain not estimable. SIMCE also fails to reach the threshold in every cohort. A separate funnel shows attrition from 414 entries to at most 8 supported cases. Each point reports its n, and a line marks the minimum of 10 units and 10 clusters. The global verdict is not estimable.
